purpose: Start the sealed StreamMill implementation through its documented HTTP server.
Show the explicit-null snapshot boundary and a real negative-time overlapping-window workflow with actual responses.
output:
Service health
GET /healthz
HTTP 200
{
  "service": "streammill",
  "status": "ok",
  "version": "0.1.0"
}

Boundary: explicit null slide_ms must be invalid_snapshot
POST /snapshot/restore
HTTP 422
{
  "error": {
    "code": "invalid_snapshot",
    "message": "stream 'null-probe': slide_ms must be a positive integer no larger than window_ms that evenly divides it"
  }
}

State after rejected restore must be empty
GET /snapshot
HTTP 200
{
  "format_version": 1,
  "streams": []
}

Create a valid sliding stream
POST /streams
HTTP 201
{
  "allowed_lateness_ms": 100,
  "slide_ms": 500,
  "stream": "demo-slide",
  "window_ms": 1000
}

Accepted event timestamp_ms=-100, value=3
POST /streams/demo-slide/events
HTTP 200
{
  "dropped": false,
  "stream": "demo-slide"
}

Accepted event timestamp_ms=750, value=2
POST /streams/demo-slide/events
HTTP 200
{
  "dropped": false,
  "stream": "demo-slide"
}

Accepted event timestamp_ms=1000, value=5
POST /streams/demo-slide/events
HTTP 200
{
  "dropped": false,
  "stream": "demo-slide"
}

Advance watermark and observe all overlapping results
POST /streams/demo-slide/watermark
HTTP 200
{
  "finalized": [
    {
      "count": 1,
      "stream": "demo-slide",
      "sum": 3,
      "window_end_ms": 0,
      "window_start_ms": -1000
    },
    {
      "count": 1,
      "stream": "demo-slide",
      "sum": 3,
      "window_end_ms": 500,
      "window_start_ms": -500
    },
    {
      "count": 1,
      "stream": "demo-slide",
      "sum": 2,
      "window_end_ms": 1000,
      "window_start_ms": 0
    },
    {
      "count": 2,
      "stream": "demo-slide",
      "sum": 7,
      "window_end_ms": 1500,
      "window_start_ms": 500
    },
    {
      "count": 1,
      "stream": "demo-slide",
      "sum": 5,
      "window_end_ms": 2000,
      "window_start_ms": 1000
    }
  ],
  "stream": "demo-slide",
  "watermark_ms": 2100
}
